entities.summary: Agnelo Gustavo Adolfo de Souza SFX, was a Portuguese Roman Catholic priest of the Society of Pilar who performed missionary work in Goa, then part of Portuguese India. The cause for his beatification has been accepted for investigation by the Holy See, and has progressed to the point that he has been declared venerable.
